content.text: can you pull fixes and see if there is a fix for the opencode memory leak?

Using drovr:using-drovr — routing check. This is read-only investigation first (find how opencode is pinned, check upstream for leak fixes); no code written yet, so no `drovr:tdd`. If it turns into a flake bump I'll run `drovr:code-review` before calling it done.
